title: Script stream byte peek
summary: Recover thiscall peek at VA 0x4f6040: inspect buffered unsigned byte, or refill through a cdecl callback; return -1 for null/empty refill without consuming data. Original temporary consume/restore and unreachable unsigned-byte EOF comparison are simplified.
test_description: Compare original thiscall oracle and member implementation across 400 cases: zero/nonzero/high-bit/max counts, null/non-null callback results, bytes 0/127/128/255, callback mutation, repeated peeks; verify callback ABI and invocation count, all stream fields, guard words, returned value and nonconsumption.
known_limits: 32-bit original object layout; pointer fields naturally widen on 64-bit ports.
Callback semantic identities and enclosing object type remain unresolved; field names describe observed usage.
Reader must initialize output count when returning a non-null buffer; invalid pointers, asynchronous modification, exception paths and device internals are outside the tested contract.
Temporary consume/restore stores and duplicate byte load are simplified for ordinary single-threaded memory; no byte-matching claim.
